manifest.name: @anweat/dsh-browser
manifest.description: Browser runtime plugin for DeepSeek Harness (scoped @anweat) — ships Playwright and Patchright, uses your system Chrome / Edge (or a Playwright Chromium you install), optionally drives OpenCLI site adapters, exposes a `browser` service and interactive browser tools.

scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:peers && pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run test:client-bundle && pnpm run docs:check

bundle.text:
# dsh-browser bundle patch — installs the browser runtime as one more row over
# the active profile. Install with:
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add @anweat/dsh-browser
# then boot the profile (the web profile has HMR disabled, so a restart applies it).
#
# Supports DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2 to rc.4 (see the peer ranges in package.json).
#
# Login state: prefer named `authProfiles` with explicit `allowedDomains` (see
# README). `storageStatePath` remains as a legacy global fallback.
#
# The Host's Settings service saves editable config as a separate top-level row of
# the profile's own patch (`- id: browser` with `config`), and a patch replaces its
# target row's whole `config`. So this insert row carries no config: the Config schema
# defaults supply the initial values and the profile row holds the saved settings.
#
# Settings: everything under `config` of that row is editable in the settings card (Settings -> Plugins -> Browser
# automation): a status summary, nine collapsible groups (only "Common" is open), drop-downs and switches for the choices,
# lists with dialogs for login profiles / prompts / assets, and a save bar. The README's "配置" section lists every key
# with its allowed values, default and risk as comments; the card's "Advanced: text mode" prints the same, in your language.
#
# Model-facing text (tool descriptions, root guide/note, summaries, error hints, skill) can be
# overridden under `prompts` in that config row. The card's Prompts group ("Export default text") and
# `node scripts/dump-prompts.mjs --yaml` in a repository checkout print every default as commented YAML (each section says
# which layer the model reads it in, its length cap and when a change applies); without --yaml it prints JSON.
# See README "自定义提示文本".
- insert:
    - id: browser
      name: '@anweat/dsh-browser'

readme.text:
[English](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/README.en.md) | 中文

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的浏览器运行时插件：让模型打开网页、读取内容、操作页面、截图、下载文件，也为 `dsh-web-search-pro` 提供 `browser` 服务。插件自带 Playwright / Patchright 驱动，**浏览器本身不随插件下载**：装了 Google Chrome 或 Microsoft Edge 就直接用。

- **两个常驻工具**：`browser_index`（看目录）+ `browser_call`（执行动作），常驻上下文约 325 token；41 个动作分成 9 组，按需查看单个动作的 schema。
- **不用先下载浏览器**：自动检测系统 Chrome / Edge；都没有时才用 `runtime.install` 安装 Playwright Chromium。可选 Patchright 内核。
- **严格定位与结构化观察**：`role` / `name` / `label` / `text` / `testId` 语义定位，匹配多个元素时不执行并列出候选；`observe.read` 可直接给出可用于 `act.*` 的 controls / links / tables。
- **按 session 隔离、四档自动化自由度**：每个 session 独立的浏览器 context；`read-only` / `standard` / `autonomous` / `unrestricted` 决定能做什么、哪些要走 DSH 原生审批。
- **登录态、下载与限流**：按域名限定的 `authProfile`，下载落盘带 sha256，`usagePolicy` 限制并发与突发；模型可通过策略动作收紧或（经审批）放宽。
- **可复用自动化（实验性）**：recipe / UserScript 资产的积累、检索、测试与手动激活；OpenCLI 站点 adapter 可选。
安全边界与 2026-09 的审查记录见 [AUDIT.md](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/AUDIT.md)（基于 0.1.12，部分内容已过时）：`allowedDomains` 只限制登录态装载，不是网络防火墙或 Agent 隔离边界。

范围之外的宿主版本未经验证。历史版本、升级说明见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)；peer 范围为什么写成两段见 [docs/dev/host-compat.md](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/dev/host-compat.md)。

**DSH CLI**（以 `web` profile 为例）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @anweat/dsh-browser@0.2.2

本地源码 checkout 的版本号可能与已发布的有出入，需要在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里对齐版本后重装。`dsh plugin add` 在 pnpm 11 下应当直接成功、退出码 0；排障时才需要手改 profile 的 `package.json`。

1. **重启后找到设置卡片**：设置页的“插件”里，`@anweat/dsh-browser` 的配置卡片标题是“浏览器自动化”。顶部**状态摘要**直接说明运行环境：

2. **确认浏览器**：让模型调用 `browser_call({action:"runtime.status"})`（或看状态摘要），`browser.ready` 为 `true` 即可。
   - 有 Chrome / Edge：自动使用，不下载任何东西。Playwright 的 Chromium 一旦下载过就改用它；填了 `executablePath`，或把 `channel` 设为 `chrome` / `msedge`，则固定用你指定的那个，找不到就报错。

3. **可选依赖**：

   - **dsh-web-search-pro**：它在运行时读取本插件提供的 `browser` 服务来做页面快照、`playwright` 抓取和搜索页类平台，两者可独立安装；这些浏览器类能力需要本插件在场。

readme.text:
- 访问本机地址的 `target.open` 不需要额外权限，也不需要登录 profile。
- **审批**：`standard`（默认）下 `act.*` 要走 DSH 审批；会话的审批策略为 `never` 时，所有需要询问的动作都会被自动拒绝，这时把 `automationMode` 设为 `autonomous`，页面交互就直接执行。`script.evaluate`、`act.upload` 在 `autonomous` 下仍会询问，只有 `unrestricted` 才跳过。
- **登录态**：要在本机地址上带登录态，配 `authProfiles`（`allowedDomains: [127.0.0.1]`，状态文件必须存在）。如果希望由 agent 经 `runtime.set_auth_profile` 自己写这类 loopback / 内网域名，需要 `allowPrivateHosts: true`（默认关）；在会话审批策略为 `never` 时放宽动作会被拒绝，请直接在配置里写。
- **截图**：`observe.screenshot` 把文件存进 `snapshotDir`（默认 `$DSH_HOME/data/browser/snapshots`），结果里的 `path` 交给宿主的 `read_image` 工具（参数 `file_path`）读成图片；`read_image` 由宿主提供，不是本插件的工具。`target.open` 的结果里也带全页截图路径。
- 需要固定视口（例如手机尺寸）：`target.open` 的 `viewport` 参数，或配置 `viewportMode`，见 [下载与上下文选项](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/guide/downloads-and-context.md)。

readme.section: 然后调用宿主的 read_image 工具
readme.text: **公开网页**：`target.open` → `observe.read` 读文本，`observe.screenshot` 截图；表单用 `act.fill` / `act.click`，`standard` 下每次询问一次。

模型先用 `browser_index` 看目录（无参数列出分组和环境状态；`{group}` 列动作；`{action}` 给完整参数 schema；`{query}` 关键词检索），再用 `browser_call({action, args})` 执行。所有动作返回同一种信封 `{ok, action, executionStatus, result | error{code,message,hint}}`。把 `toolSurface` 设为 `flat` 可以改成每个动作一个工具（常驻约 17.4k token，仅用于对照与调试）。

| 组 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `runtime` | 运行时状态、Chromium 安装、登录 profile 与限流的策略覆盖层 |
| `target` | 打开 / 关闭 / 列出 / 切换页面，下载文件 |
| `observe` | 读页面文本、结构化观察（controls / links / tables）、截图 |
| `act` | 点击、填写、输入、清空、按键、选择、勾选、悬停、滚动、上传、等待 |
| `inspect` | console 与失败请求、下载记录、生效的策略 |
| `script` | 页面 JavaScript、内置只读脚本、UserScript |
| `automation` | 检索 / 运行可复用资产、开发草稿、内联 recipe |
| `crawl` | 有界多页遍历 |
| `opencli` | OpenCLI 站点 adapter |

完整动作目录、错误码、严格定位和审批规则见 [工具与动作](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/guide/tools-and-actions.md) 与 [自动化自由度与审批](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/guide/automation-modes.md)。插件随包提供 `dsh-browser` skill，教模型复用优先、定位策略和按错误码处理失败。

所有网页访问、交互、脚本、Cookie 使用、上传和下载都必须由调用方或操作者根据目标网站规则及适用要求判断并使用；插件只执行被请求或批准的浏览器操作，不判断用途是否获得网站授权。
在设置卡片里改，或写进 profile 的配置文件（完整带注释的示例见 [配置参考](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/guide/configuration.md)）。**保存后需要重启 profile 才生效**（只有提示文本覆盖按调用实时读取）。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `automationMode` | `standard` | `read-only` 只读 \| `standard` 写操作逐次审批 \| `autonomous` 页面交互直接执行 \| `unrestricted` 全部免审批（仅隔离环境） |
| `toolSurface` | `indexed` | `indexed` 两个常驻工具；`flat` 每个动作一个工具 |
| `channel` | `chromium` | `chromium`（Playwright 的 Chromium，没装时自动用系统 Chrome / Edge）\| `chrome` \| `msedge`（固定用） |
| `headless` | `true` | `false` 显示浏览器窗口 |
| `executablePath` | 空 | 自定义浏览器可执行文件的绝对路径 |
| `browserRuntime` | `playwright` | `patchright`：仅 Chromium，对自动化检测更友好 |
| `opencliEnabled` | `true` | OpenCLI 总开关；没装 OpenCLI 时只是 `opencli.*` 不可用 |
| `authProfiles` / `defaultAuthProfile` | 空 | 按域名限定的登录态（`allowedDomains`、`storageStatePath`、`persistState`） |
| `allowPrivateHosts` | `false` | 允许 agent 把 localhost / 内网地址写进登录域名 |
| `downloadDir` / `downloadMaxBytes` | `$DSH_HOME/data/browser/downloads` / 100 MiB | 下载目录与单个文件上限 |
另有视口、`userAgent`、`locale`、`timezoneId`、代理（`viewportMode`、`proxyServer` 等）、`usagePolicy` 限流、`automationAssets` 与 `prompts`，见配置参考。

- 用户指南（中文）：[文档索引](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/README.md) 列出 `docs/guide/` 下每一篇——配置参考、设置卡片、工具与动作、Playwright Recipe、自动化资产、审批、策略覆盖层、使用策略、下载与上下文、登录态与 OpenCLI、内核与依赖、提示文本、UserScript、`browser` 服务。
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)：各版本的兼容范围与升级说明。
- 开发者文档：[docs/dev/](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/dev/build-and-release.md)（构建与发布、宿主兼容）、[docs/validation/](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/tree/master/docs/validation)（验证记录）。
MIT

A browser runtime plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). It lets the model open web pages, read them, operate them, take screenshots and download files, and it provides the `browser` service that `dsh-web-search-pro` builds on. The plugin ships the Playwright and Patchright drivers; **it does not download a browser**: if Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge is installed, it uses that.
> The detailed guides under `docs/guide/` are written in Chinese. This README covers everything you need to install, configure and try the plugin in English.

- **Two always-on tools**: `browser_index` (browse the catalog) and `browser_call` (run an action). About 325 tokens of resident context; 41 actions in 9 groups, with the schema of one action shown on demand.
- **No browser download needed**: the system Chrome or Edge is detected automatically; Playwright's Chromium is installed (`runtime.install`) only when neither exists. Patchright is an optional engine.
- **Strict locators and structured observation**: semantic locators (`role` / `name` / `label` / `text` / `testId`); a locator that matches several elements does nothing and lists the candidates. `observe.read` returns controls, links and tables with locators you can pass straight to `act.*`.
- **Per-session isolation and four automation modes**: every session gets its own browser context. `read-only`, `standard`, `autonomous` and `unrestricted` decide what is possible and what goes through DSH's native approval.
- **Login state, downloads and rate limits**: domain-scoped `authProfile`s, downloads saved with a sha256, `usagePolicy` caps for concurrency and bursts. The model can tighten these through policy actions, or loosen them with approval.
- **Reusable automation (experimen

Security boundaries and the September 2026 review are in [AUDIT.md](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/AUDIT.md) (written against 0.1.12, partly outdated; in Chinese). Note that `allowedDomains` only limits which login state is loaded. It is not a network firewall or an agent isolation boundary.

| Plugin | DSH | Peer ranges |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.2` (current) | `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2` to `rc.4` (tested on 0.2.0-rc.2, 0.2.1-rc.3, 0.2.1-rc.4) | DSH packages `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.1-0 \|\| >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0`; `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `~4.0.4` |
| `0.1.17` (pin this on 0.1.7-line hosts) | `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2` | the older `browser_*` tool set |

Host versions outside these ranges are not verified. Older versions and upgrade notes are in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) (Chinese). Why the peer range has two segments is explained in [docs/dev/host-compat.md](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/dev/host-compat.md) (Chinese).

readme.section: each line is the arguments of one browser_call
then call the host's read_image tool
readme.text:
- `target.open` on a loopback address needs no extra permission and no auth profile.
- **Approval**: under `standard` (the default) `act.*` goes through DSH approval. When the session's approval policy is `never`, every action that would ask is rejected automatically; set `automationMode` to `autonomous` and page interactions run directly. `script.evaluate` and `act.upload` still ask under `autonomous`; only `unrestricted` skips them.
- **Login state**: to use a login state on a local address, configure `authProfiles` with `allowedDomains: [127.0.0.1]` (the state file must exist). If you want the agent to write such a loopback or private-network domain itself through `runtime.set_auth_profile`, `allowPrivateHosts: true` is required (off by default). Loosening is rejected when the approval policy is `never`, so put it in the configuration yourself.
- **Screenshots**: `observe.screenshot` saves into `snapshotDir` (default `$DSH_HOME/data/browser/snapshots`) and returns `path`; pass it to the host's `read_image` tool (parameter `file_path`) to see the image. `read_image` belongs to the host, not to this plugin. The result of `target.open` also carries a full-page screenshot path.
- A

readme.section: then call the host's read_image tool
readme.text: **A public page**: `target.open`, then `observe.read` for the text and `observe.screenshot` for an image. Forms use `act.fill` and `act.click`, which ask once per call under `standard`.

readme.section: Tools and actions at a glance
readme.text: The model first looks at the catalog with `browser_index` (no arguments: groups and environment state; `{group}`: the actions of a group; `{action}`: the full parameter schema; `{query}`: keyword search), then runs `browser_call({action, args})`. Every action returns the same envelope, `{ok, action, executionStatus, result | error{code,message,hint}}`. Setting `toolSurface` to `flat` registers one tool per action instead (about 17.4k tokens resident; for comparison and debugging only).

readme.section: Tools and actions at a glance
readme.text:
| Group | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `runtime` | runtime status, Chromium install, policy overlay for auth profiles and usage limits |
| `target` | open / close / list / switch pages, download files |
| `observe` | read page text, structured observation (controls / links / tables), screenshots |
| `act` | click, fill, type, clear, press, select, check, hover, scroll, upload, wait |
| `inspect` | console and failed requests, download records, the effective policy |
| `script` | page JavaScript, built-in read-only scripts, UserScripts |
| `automation` | search and run reusable assets, develop drafts, inline recipes |
| `crawl` | bounded multi-page crawl |
| `opencli` | OpenCLI site adapters |

readme.section: Tools and actions at a glance
readme.text: The full action catalog, error codes, strict locators and approval rules are in [tools and actions](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/guide/tools-and-actions.md) and [automation modes and approval](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/guide/automation-modes.md) (Chinese). The package ships a `dsh-browser` skill that teaches the model to reuse first, locate carefully and handle failures by error code.

readme.section: Tools and actions at a glance
readme.text: Callers and operators are responsible for judging, under the target site's rules and the applicable requirements, whether any page access, interaction, script, cookie use, upload or download is allowed. The plugin only performs the browser operations that were requested or approved; it does not judge whether a purpose is authorized by a site.

Change them in the settings card, or in the profile configuration (a fully commented example is in the [configuration reference](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/guide/configuration.md), in Chinese). **A saved change needs a profile restart to take effect** (only prompt text overrides are read on every call).

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `automationMode` | `standard` | `read-only` \| `standard` (writes ask each time) \| `autonomous` (page interaction runs directly) \| `unrestricted` (no approval at all; isolated environments only) |
| `toolSurface` | `indexed` | `indexed`: two resident tools; `flat`: one tool per action |
| `channel` | `chromium` | `chromium` (Playwright's Chromium, falling back to system Chrome / Edge when not installed) \| `chrome` \| `msedge` (pinned) |
| `headless` | `true` | `false` shows the browser window |
| `executablePath` | empty | absolute path of a custom browser executable |
| `browserRuntime` | `playwright` | `patchright`: Chromium only, friendlier to automation detection |
| `opencliEnabled` | `true` | master switch for OpenCLI; without OpenCLI installed it only makes `opencli.*` unavailable |
| `authProfiles` / `defaultAuthProfile` | empty | domain-scoped login states (`allowedDomains`, `storageStatePath`, `persistState`) |
| `allowPrivateHosts` | `false` | lets the agent put localhost and private-network addresses into login domains |
| `downloadDir` / `downloadMaxBytes` | `$DSH_HOME/data/browser/downloads` / 100 MiB | download directory

Also available: viewport, `userAgent`, `locale`, `timezoneId` and proxy (`viewportMode`, `proxyServer`, ...), `usagePolicy` rate limits, `automationAssets` and `prompts`; see the configuration reference.

- User guides (Chinese): the [documentation index](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/README.md) lists every file under `docs/guide/`: configuration reference, settings card, tools and actions, Playwright recipes, automation assets, approval, policy overlay, usage policy, downloads and context options, login state and OpenCLI, runtime and dependencies, prompt text, UserScripts, the `browser` service.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): compatibility and upgrade notes per version (Chinese).
- Developer docs: [docs/dev/](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/blob/master/docs/dev/build-and-release.md) (build and release, host compatibility) and [docs/validation/](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-browser/tree/master/docs/validation) (validation records).
